world-production.title: World Agricultural Production
world-production.boundary: All required numeric production, area and yield tables in this family, including non-grain crops. Report-specific metrics remain in scope even if PSD mapping is unavailable.

grain-trade.title: Grain: World Markets and Trade
grain-trade.boundary: All grain production, supply, consumption, trade and stock tables in this report family; preserve local marketing year versus trade year.

oilseed-trade.title: Oilseeds: World Markets and Trade
oilseed-trade.boundary: All oilseed, protein meal and vegetable oil supply, production, processing, consumption, trade and stock tables in this report family.

ers.enterprise_types: all linked enterprise types, including each hog enterprise separately
ers.methods: retain series family, survey base year, regional definitions and method differences
ers.historical_products: include all files linked in Historical, including discontinued products; default year filter may yield no observations for a series ending before 2010

rma.layout_policy: 1989-forward layout inventory; verify actual years in Phase 07; 1948-1988 is a distinct earlier layout requiring explicit unsupported-history reporting
rma.quantity_types: preserve source quantity type; never assume all quantities are acres

exclusions: ERS separately linked Milk Cost of Production Estimates product

version_policy.raw: preserve source bytes and later revisions
version_policy.api_history: current revised historical series and future captured snapshots; unavailable historical monthly API vintages are not promised
version_policy.report_archives: archive available reports within report-date interval; keep evidenced gaps visible

api_inventory_expansion.rule: Authenticated dictionaries expand all ESR commodities and only the three frozen PSD report families. Discover supported periods per series. Retain unmapped required report tables for Phase 06; never silently drop them. Dictionary codes and API response fields remain unverified until their source phases.

scope_change_policy: Log changes in docs/decisions.md, update expected coverage and run affected regression checks.
